scope: Independent merged design and existing connected production source review; no new product implementation accepted by this receipt.
required_acceptance_groups: Closed exact fourteen-key body and thirteen-key receipt; canonical bounded scalars/timestamps, duplicate/null/alias rejection; exact authenticated scope/credential generation; rank and recorded/coalesced semantics including original retained recorded time.

Common current-binary disk ownership acquired before ALL constructor cache I/O, both legacy and opted-in modes; stable inode and nonblocking contention, lifecycle release; trusted parent limitation and unsupported-platform refusal for ACK only.

Atomic v2 envelope/original witness/pending write, file and directory durability plus exact readback before eligible ACK; no in-memory/legacy/load-time backfill; immutable same-source witness across replay/restart/Current highwater rewrites; newer source supersedes uncertain pending without false noncommit claims.

Optional current-generation/expiry authority seam preserves original decision authority equality; old witness never relabeled on credential rotation; independent joined ACK worker cannot block policy refresh/revocation/decisions or clear newer pending from stale responses.

Actual signed HTTP/client and current shared pool fixed record/typed receipt/exact confirm/COMMIT ordering. Revoke/rotate/wallclock expiry after organization/device/table waits; unknown commit has no typed success. Own profile failures affect ACK route only, preserving original readiness/health/security operations.

Own namespace exact current normal/audit source/operator seals and registered gateway role, closed ACL/default-ACL refusal and minimal explicit grants; immutable original migrations and device replay/applied-generation semantics preserved.

Opt-in deployment/release flags confined to actual runtime-gateway producer and gateway-control server consumers; legacy defaults unchanged, no new principals/grants/coverage shortcuts. Grouped affected regression plus UI typecheck/build before publication.
source_findings: Existing gatewayHTTPControl.Authority projects out generation/expiry; optional ACK authority capability is needed rather than broad legacy authority-equality changes.
Existing disk constructor and Current/Store rewrite mutable observedAt. New witness must survive each current writer and remain independent of antirollback highwater.

Existing gateway-control cachedControlRepository embeds only original Repository interface; selected new capability must be forwarded explicitly instead of silently disappearing behind the readiness wrapper.

Existing authorization80 gateway lock orders organization before device serialization, with registered role and wallclock credential check. New own record/confirm functions must share current actual writer order and recheck after later waits.
Pinned actual parent os.Root is existing path defense; neither parent owner-private mode nor hostile-parent isolation is asserted by the merged ownership design.
proof_limits: Source/design review only; no Go/Node/test/network/native execution by reviewer.
No SQL parse, native PostgreSQL/OpenFGA application fixture or deployed Stytch/provider/browser acceptance evidence.
No product completion, ledger promotion, native admission or launch clearance.
Current authors must freeze implementation for independent source review after grouped actual root acceptance; this design receipt does not approve future code.
